title: Concept: Overly broad file permissions (shell) — review required
description: In shell, chmod 777 app.sh sets permission bits that include world access. Broad modes on code, keys, or data turn any local account into a writer or reader. The remedy is least-privilege modes via 0755/0644 least privilege.
applicability: shell code and scripts setting file modes; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Local tampering or disclosure; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for executables, keys, and configuration.
